title: Beyond Traditional Risk Management: AI Techniques for Enhanced Risk Modeling
summary: This is the code repository for a PhD thesis at Tohoku University exploring AI techniques for project risk management, including a chapter on data augmentation via deep generative models to enlarge small project-risk datasets. SDV's sdv.single_table CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer are fit and sampled to generate synthetic data, with sdv.evaluation.single_table's evaluate_quality and rdt categorical transformers used to build and assess the augmented datasets.
evidence: chapters_code/Chapter_4/asia/Synthetic/CTGAN/CTGAN.ipynb:31-52 fits CTGANSynthesizer and samples synthetic rows; evaluate_quality called in Similarity.ipynb notebooks
